anomalies.description: A group of individuals, some wearing yellow vests and hooded clothing, are actively breaking a large glass storefront window using objects (e.g., poles, fists). The window progressively shatters across frames f0–f13, with multiple participants involved in the destruction. In later frames (f14–f15), the scene widens to show a street-level confrontation involving barricades, more yellow-vested individuals, and apparent police presence, consistent with a riotous situation.

A group of individuals collectively and violently attack a large glass storefront window, causing progressive shattering; multiple people are seen striking the glass with objects or fists, consistent with riotous behavior.

A helicopter flies over a silhouetted eagle statue against an overcast sky, suggesting aerial surveillance or presence during unrest; no direct violence visible in these frames but context implies ongoing protest activity.

A small fire burns at the base of a makeshift wooden structure, with orange high-visibility vests and plastic sheeting involved; individuals are present nearby, consistent with protest encampment or barricade burning.; A group of people, many wearing yellow vests, are gathered around a burning barricade made of wood, plastic sheeting, and orange safety vests; flames and smoke intensify over time, with individuals actively present near the fire in an urban street setting, consistent with a protest-related riot.

A larger fire burns on a cobblestone street, surrounded by multiple people wearing yellow vests; some individuals appear to be tending to or observing the fire, indicating active participation in a protest-related fire event.; A group of individuals wearing yellow vests are gathered around a burning barricade (wood, metal, and a trash bin) on a cobblestone street; smoke is rising, and participants are actively adding materials and observing the fire, indicating collective violent unrest.; A group of individuals in yellow vests surrounds and sets fire to a street object (likely a trash bin or barrier), producing large flames and thick black smoke; this constitutes collective violent unrest with property destruction.; Multiple individuals in yellow vests actively dig up and remove sections of the sidewalk/road surface using tools (shovels, bars), creating debris and open trenches; this is coordinated destructive activity typical of rioting behavior.

A group of individuals wearing yellow vests are collectively engaged in destructive activity on a city street, including digging up and removing sections of the road surface and sidewalk with tools (e.g., crowbars, shovels), scattering debris, and moving earth. The coordinated effort, presence of multiple participants, and destruction of public infrastructure constitute violent unrest.; Group of individuals in yellow vests walking through a street with debris and a disturbed patch of earth; background shows a line of people in yellow vests, suggesting organized unrest or protest escalation.; Severe property damage: storefront window (Jean Baille) shattered, glass and debris on sidewalk, with flowers placed nearby—indicative of vandalism during collective unrest.; Shattered storefront windows with debris on the sidewalk, indicating violent damage to commercial property; people are present in the background but not actively engaged in violence in these frames.

At approximately 40.5–41.5 seconds, two individuals (one in a yellow vest, one in dark clothing) engage in direct physical combat: they grapple, push, and appear to strike each other near the disturbed earth. This is mutual physical combat, distinct from the broader riot activity.
Damaged traffic light lying on wet pavement with green lights still illuminated, suggesting recent forceful impact during unrest.
Traffic light unit lying on wet pavement with green lights still illuminated, indicating it was forcibly removed or knocked down during unrest; bystanders observe nearby.

Multiple traffic light units are lying on a wet street, illuminated green, indicating recent violent disruption; the adjacent Allianz Global Investors building shows large shattered glass panels and broken entryway, with onlookers present — consistent with collective violent unrest or property destruction.
ATM machine with its screen shattered (cracked glass), while card reader and keypad remain functional (green light active), consistent with targeted vandalism during civil unrest.
